summary_1line: An old woman serves the ascetic Ashtavakra with sensual care and again attempts to seduce him, but he refuses due to moral principles.

image_candidates.scene_text: An aged woman gently anoints the seated ascetic Ashtavakra with fragrant oil in a quiet palace chamber before his ritual bath.
The old woman washes the ascetic with warm water through the night while he sits on a splendid seat, unaware that dawn has arrived.
At midnight the old woman leaves her bed and approaches the ascetic’s couch, attempting to lie beside him in the dimly lit chamber.
